subject: french
title: Saying Your Name
welcome_lead: Je m'appelle and asking 'what's your name?'
meta_desc: KS3 French: introducing yourself, names, age.
final_note: Tell someone your name and you've started a conversation.

walkthroughs.body_html: To say your name: Je m'appelle + your name. So 'Je m'appelle Sam' = 'I'm called Sam'. To ask: Comment t'appelles-tu?
Ask: Comment ca va? Reply: Ca va bien (I'm well) or just ca va (OK). Then ask back: Et toi?
When introduced to someone new, say Enchante (m) or Enchantee (f) — 'pleased to meet you'. Shake hands or, between friends, exchange cheek kisses (les bises).
